args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: a shield bash that RINGS like a struck bell or gong: from one small bright impact point, many concentric resonating sound-wave rings spread out in all directions like ripples on water seen slightly from the side, each ring a vibrating wavy band (not a blade or crescent), rings get thinner and fainter outward, steel-blue and pale cream with amber glints, small musical-vibration tick marks and tiny sparks between the rings. Compact but richly rendered, a beginner skill: the effect fills about half of the canvas, not an explosion, no fire, no magic runes. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the style image: solid parts (dust puffs, pebbles) have bold dark outlines and 3-4 step shading; glowing parts are bright with a hot near-white core fading to saturated color with a darker colored rim, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur, no thin single-pixel line art. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no creatures, no weapons, no text, transparent background.
